snippet.title: Wonderful Neoran Valley - A Roguelite Monster Collector
snippet.description:
FULLY FUNDED IN 10 MINUTES!
Recruit powerful creatures to your team, plan ahead in battles, venture into the Valley to uncover a dark truth, and if you fail... do it all over again!
Wonderful Neoran Valley is now live on Kickstarter!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/narastudio/wonderful-neoran-valley

It's a very fun game! Discover more on www.wonderfulneoranvalley.com

For business inquiries contact business@narastudio.it
